# NXDNReflector-Dashboard2

> Live status dashboard for G4KLX NXDNReflector amateur-radio talkgroups.

This website is a web dashboard operators install next to NXDNReflector. It shows linked NXDN repeaters, last-heard callsigns, the current transmitter, and host CPU/disk stats. It is not a radio and does not carry voice traffic.

- Project: https://github.com/ShaYmez/NXDNReflector-Dashboard2
- License: GPL-3.0
- Typical page: connected repeaters, last heard, system information
- Config lives in /config/ (not public) after setup.php is removed
